1257: ## Required Product Scenarios
1258: 
1259: One exact installed `pre_rc_candidate` must pass the four selected pre-RC
1260: scenarios `ABG5-S01`, `ABG5-S02`, `ABG5-S03`, and `ABG5-S06` and
1261: become eligible to authorize an RC. `ABG5-S07` then preserves the distinct
1262: subjects of the release lifecycle. `ABG5-S04` and `ABG5-S05` retain their identities
1263: as planned 5.1 scenarios and are not 5.0 gates. Every selected scenario uses the
1264: same public product path; no scenario may introduce a feature-specific harness
1265: or alternate authority.
1266: 
1267: ### `ABG5-S01`: Clean Install And Minimal Invocation
1268: 
1269: Pack the exact candidate, install it in a clean temporary location, verify and
1270: bind the product, admit its catalog, resolve
1271: `program://abiogenesis/conformance/hello-world@5` and
1272: `graph-function://abiogenesis/conformance/hello-world@5`, invoke the function
1273: through the public CLI, and read its typed result and replay without source
1274: imports or private paths.

286: **REQ-P-POLICY-038**: The public `gtl_program` variant of
287: `abg.operation.conformance.evaluate` shall accept a submitted GTL program and
288: return a typed conformance result with program or inventory
289: identity, passed or failed disposition, stable diagnostics, violated law or
290: contract references, evidence, and admissible repair affordances. It shall not
291: silently repair or execute an inadmissible program.

8: `@abiogenesis/typescript-tenant/public` exports
9: `constructInstalledPublicDefinitionCall` and its typed explicit input. It is
10: deterministic construction of an invocation candidate, not runtime admission
11: or execution. The implementation moves from test support into the Public owner;
12: test support re-exports that function by the public package specifier.
13: 
14: The caller supplies the installed Product canonical JSON/hash functions,
15: installed Public family/projections, verified definition coordinates, exact
16: contract catalog, operation/member selection, request, authority slots,
17: resource assertion, refs, event time and provenance. There are no implicit
18: selection defaults. Product verification remains the source of coordinates;
19: this helper is not a substitute for verification.
20: 
21: The constructor selects one exact definition/operation/member, checks slot
22: catalog, operation, version, selector, key, slot and definition ref against the
23: installed owner projection, then preserves the supplied coordinates. It hashes
24: the same authority, request and invocation preimages as the predecessor helper
25: and derives the same invocation ref. Request, slots and resources retain their
26: identity. Provenance is copied and frozen; construction does not deep-freeze
27: caller values or acquire resources.
28: 
29: Transport and the exact selected owners retain complete raw contract and
30: semantic admission. Construction does not admit capabilities, request meaning,
31: resource assertions, runtime events or outcomes. GTL declares; HoG traverses;
32: ABG admits. Existing transport and CLI receive the same DefinitionCall envelope.

70: The path is **external/raw input → owning admission → established typed internal
71: values → additional operation-owned relations/currentness → admitted change**.
72: An owner establishes only the facts within its contract. Same-process origin,
73: `F_D`, a TypeScript cast, matching digest or successful construction does not
74: admit a value or authorize an effect. A structurally admitted wire result does
75: not thereby satisfy a target contract or substantive judgment.
76: 
77: | Boundary | Checks retained by the existing owner | Work reusable after those checks |
78: |---|---|---|
79: | Supplied Product, lock and declarations | Exact bytes, identities, schemas, dependency/contract linkage and provenance; installed physical correspondence where required | The unchanged verified body, resolved linkage and validated lock inside their lawful owner scope; a later operation checks its membership/selection and actual physical currentness rather than rebuilding the same body |
80: | Raw Public/serialized request | Selected definition/contract, structural schema, supplied authority, request/resource correspondence and permissions | Established immutable constituents across native calls; detach mutable caller input without first copying an unchanged verified body merely to restore it |
81: | Proposed runtime change | Authentic current predecessor, exact call/Run/binding, authority, additional semantic relation and lawful transition; preserve refusal precedence | Existing live derived state and candidate delta; refusal leaves the accepted predecessor unchanged |
82: | Raw `F_P` output and subsequent use | Schema and call/attempt/input/contract correspondence; eligible references and evidence; authority/currentness, substantive judgment and lawful transition | The actual checked result and established facts, scoped to the exact result/basis; a downstream owner still judges every additional relation it owns |
83: | Ordinary query and genuine recovery | Exact requested source/prefix, current read authority, typed absence/refusal and resource ownership | Live projections for queries against that owned state; cold acquisition/recovery reconstructs equivalent facts from the log and immutable inputs |
84: 
85: Reuse follows actual owner-established values and their exact basis, not a new
86: registry, cache, controller, trust token or required process-local semantic
87: authority. Serialized/reacquired data crosses its ordinary admission boundary;
88: a cast cannot replace it. A changed subject, contract, dependency, prefix or
89: physical observation requires the corresponding owner check. Prior immutable
90: facts remain historical facts; reuse does not make an old permission, witness
91: or worksite observation current. Existing physical resource lifetime ownership
92: continues to govern borrowing, successor selection, append and genuine close.

111: ### Conformance Definition resource receipt
112: 
113: `conformance.evaluate/gtl_program` preserves its complete semantic result and
114: refusal algebra. Its read-only `DefinitionReturn.resources` is a
115: `ConformanceEvaluationResourceReceipt`: existing invocation, request and
116: capability-grant coordinates, not an echo of the packet, declared inventory or
117: catalog. The admitted grants already bind the exact approved resource scope;
118: this receipt adds no admission authority. Host exit/failure and invocation
119: association remain unchanged. Real event-resource completions from effect
120: owners remain their existing handoffs; this read-only receipt invents none.
121: Historical full resource receipts retain their original bytes and meaning.
122: 
123: Within this conformance call, the owner reconstructs the declaration basis and
124: resolves its exact Program closure once. Its internal validation continuation
125: consumes that actual closure, while preserving packet/publication correspondence,
126: raw declaration admission and `validateProgram`. The raw catalog/conformance
127: entries still authenticate a supplied closure against its complete catalog and
128: view. Equal-body catalog construction, cold/raw readiness and all additional
129: operation-owned relations remain unchanged; no cross-call catalog authority or
130: process-identity registry is introduced.
